<function name="asin" parent="math" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns the [arcsine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inverse_trigonometric_functions) of the given number.</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="normal" type="number">Sine value in the range of -1 to 1.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">An angle in radians, in the range -pi/2 to pi/2, which has the given sine value.

<page>nan</page> if the argument is out of range.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
